parameters.content:
## Weekly SSL grade report
Every Monday the SSL Labs node assesses each host (reusing results up to 24 hours old), appends one row per host to Google Sheets and emails a summary.

Each assessment takes 1-5 minutes per IP address, so the node waits up to 30 minutes and runs 2 assessments at a time. Failed hosts are passed on as error items instead of stopping the run.

Register your email with the node's **Registration → Register** operation before the first run.
